description: Header file defining interface for a vector of strings, including function prototypes for initialization, cloning, adding, searching, removing, destroying, dumping, converting, comparing, sorting, and manipulating string vectors.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Clone
methods.description: Clones a source string vector into another.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a string to the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Add_IfNotExist
methods.description: Adds a string to the vector if it does not already exist.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Finds the index of a string in the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_RemoveByIndex
methods.description: Removes a string at a specified index.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources of the string vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of the vector for debugging.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_ConvertToKeyValueVector
methods.description: Converts string vector to a key-value vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Compare
methods.description: Compares two string vectors for equality.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_ToSortedList
methods.description: Returns a sorted comma-separated list of strings.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_ToList
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated list of strings.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_RemoveUnusedEntries
methods.description: Removes unused or redundant entries from the vector.
